name: Bidirectional Path Tracing
aliases: Bidirectional Path Tracing for Participating Media

Bidirectional Path Tracing — BPT, Bidirectional Path Tracing (BPT), Bidirectional Path Tracing for Participating Media, Bidirectional Path-Tracing, Bidirectional path tracing, Bidirectional transmittance-based path sampling, Vertex-vertex connection
definition: A method that constructs two independent subpaths (one from light, one from eye) and connects their endpoints deterministically with a segment.
summary: Bidirectional Path Tracing constructs full paths by deterministically connecting light and camera subpaths, reducing variance for complex scenes unlike probabilistic bridge sampling.
